items.title: Coppull impresses in Hungerford success
items.summary: Coppull stepped up in distance to land a second Group Two of his career under an enterprising ride from Hector Crouch, who completed a big-race double in the Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes at Newbury.

items.title: Burton 1-1 Stevenage
items.summary: Olly Sanderson bundled home in stoppage time to snatch Stevenage a point in a 1-1 draw against Burton.

items.title: Crawley 0-1 Crewe
items.summary: Josh March headed the winner in the fifth minute of stoppage time as 10-man Crewe got the better of nine-man Crawley at the Broadfield Stadium.

items.summary: Veteran striker Ched Evans scored the only goal of the game, finding the net against one of his former clubs to give Fleetwood Town an opening day 1-0 victory at Chesterfield.

items.title: Charlton hit back to beat Derby
items.summary: Tyreece Campbell's impressive start to the new season continued as his 80th-minute goal earned Charlton a 2-1 victory over Derby at The Valley.
